question: Paid SaaS: "Semrush". What people pay it for: A scheduled tracker for your own keywords via a SERP API, a technical crawl of your own site, and your own Search Console data pulled in alongside it. Question: is the candidate below an open-source or self-hostable application (web, desktop or server) that a person could actually use INSTEAD of Semrush for that job, or for a clear, substantial part of it? Partial replacements count as yes (for example a desktop video editor for a video app, a self-hosted rank tracker for an SEO suite). Answer no for: a code library or SDK only, a command-line utility with no end-user workflow, a closed paid service, a tutorial, or a tool for an unrelated job.
